decision.reason: [ev-e7cf2f463686] says only that "ServiceAccount annotations" are now run through Helm tpl on keys and values. It names no values key path, and the surrounding Feature section adds nothing. The validator found that serviceAccount.annotations is not in any chart's values file. Nothing shows whether only the controller's key or also other components' ServiceAccount annotation keys are templated, so the proposed single-key condition may be too narrow. We need the chart template or values diff from #7501 showing which annotation keys get tpl, and whether only values containing template syntax change.
